name: Sea Lord Aislinn
canonNotes: A brilliant High Elf admiral with many victories, whose ruthless, almost vicious enthusiasm many in Ulthuan's courts find distasteful.
Snobbish and callous, he will start wars in foreign lands if he thinks it serves the Asur; his sailors are utterly loyal to him.
voiceNotes: Snobbish, cutting and supremely confident in Elven superiority.
Callous toward lesser races; admires efficiency and naval strength.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
